provenance.claim_boundary: Original EXP29.04 simulated coding-task recovery comparison across every frozen task, target, crash window, policy, and repetition. It establishes no exactly-once guarantee, live tool effect, production recovery time, or Kimi/K3 agent outcome. No bounded successor is involved.

population.kind: four chapter-created synthetic repository tasks with simulated effects only
population.denominator: 4 tasks x 2 target actions x 5 crash windows x 3 policies x 10 paired repetitions = 1200 cells
population.stopping_rule: Execute every registered cell once, retaining unsafe and unresolved cells without exclusion, replacement, or outcome-dependent retry

cost_model.paired_dispatch_jitter: For each task, action, and repetition, SHA-256 of 'EXP29.04|v1|<task>|<action>|<repetition>' first byte modulo 5 is added to dispatch cost; the same value is used in all policies.

fixture.question: How do transcript replay, unchecked checkpoint resume, and validated checkpoint reconciliation behave at the same coding-task crash cuts?
